name: Whirlpool Duet Sport Dryer Motor Windings
purpose: 8178559 MCE dryer — main 2.4–3.6 Ω (pin 4–5), start 2.4–3.8 Ω (pin 4–3) at motor switch.
failureModes: Open winding — F-26 motor drive failure
Good motor ohms but open to MCE — belt switch or harness
testingTips: Test at motor pluggable switch with connector disconnected
Belt switch: infinity → few Ω when pulley pushed up

name: Whirlpool Duet Sport Electric Heater Element
purpose: Single element 7–12 Ω red-to-red at heater (8178559 §5). Not CCU dual-element ≤50 Ω.
failureModes: Open — no heat; check thermal cut-off and high-limit in series
~10 Ω element path but no heat — MCE heater relay or P14 harness
testingTips: Thermal cut-off red to heater red should read ~10 Ω when circuit intact
P14-3 to P14-6: 5–15 kΩ = bad MCE; <1 kΩ = replace thermistor

name: Whirlpool Duet Sport Exhaust Thermistor
purpose: Exhaust NTC at MCE — F-22 open / F-23 short within 60 s of Timed Dry start.
failureModes: Open — F-22 flashes, dryer shuts off
In-range ohms but wrong temp — MCE if table checks pass
testingTips: Measure at thermistor with wires removed, power disconnected
P14-3 to P14-6: <1 kΩ = replace thermistor; 5–15 kΩ = replace MCE

name: Whirlpool Duet Sport Gas Ignitor
purpose: 8178559 gas burner ignitor cold resistance 50–250 Ω.
failureModes: In spec but weak glow — check amp draw before condemning valve
testingTips: After ignitor OK, proceed to gas valve coil test (TEST #3d)

name: Whirlpool Duet Sport Gas Valve Coils
failureModes: Open coil — glow but no gas
All coils OK — flame sensor or MCE if ignitor amps good
testingTips: Use R×100 scale per job aid §5
Thermal fuse in gas valve circuit — check before valve
